image_description: A street scene featuring a traditional May Day celebration. A tall green pole (maypole) stands in the center, adorned with long colorful ribbons (red, yellow, blue, green) extending to dancers below. Morris dancers in traditional white shirts, black vests, and bells are weaving around the pole holding the ribbons. The background shows a brick building with 'BOOKS' signage and bunting flags strung across the street.
